text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing a long training session, as we were packing up...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Phew~~, I gave it my all~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
! ...Good work out there.
You really pushed yourself hard, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~... Watching Messiah-chan and the others
got me all fired up...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, at this point, I was completely unsteady on my feet and—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ? ...Did you feel something in your legs just now...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. That really startled me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: What explosive power, speed, and stamina...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I cannot afford to be left behind either...
Trainer-san, please give me additional training."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... Mr. Spider is finally gone...
...Wait, huh—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mmmh! I'm not done yet either~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed, that is overwork.
Thank you for your levelheaded judgment."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let's work twice as hard tomorrow.
